about.en: Orca is the governance token of Orca, a decentralized exchange and automated market maker on Solana known for its concentrated-liquidity Whirlpools pools. ORCA is used for governance and ecosystem incentives.
about.es: Orca es el token de gobernanza de Orca, un exchange descentralizado y automated market maker en Solana conocido por sus pools de liquidez concentrada Whirlpools. ORCA se usa para gobernanza e incentivos del ecosistema.
about.ca: Orca es el token de governanca d'Orca, un exchange descentralitzat i automated market maker a Solana conegut per les seves pools de liquiditat concentrada Whirlpools. ORCA s'usa per a governanca i incentius de l'ecosistema.
